content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Fonts online

When comparing options for selling fonts online without PayPal, it's crucial to understand what each platform offers. Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle provide ease of use and integration with various platforms, but their country restrictions and fees can be detrimental to creators. On the other hand, sovereign commerce infrastructure like COREMERCH offers a more comprehensive solution, including automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership, empowering creators to take control of their digital businesses.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

The way each option handles restricted countries is a significant differentiator. While Stripe and PayPal have strict geographical limitations, sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to be inclusive, providing creators in any country with the tools they need to sell their digital products. This infrastructure sovereignty ensures that creators are not at the mercy of platform restrictions, allowing them to focus on their business without the fear of being locked out.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment speed, fees, and real costs are critical factors to consider when choosing a platform. Traditional platforms like PayPal can hold funds for up to 180 days in case of an account suspension, and their fees can eat into a creator's profit margin. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure often utilizes crypto payments, which can offer faster transaction times and lower fees, such as the 0.5% fee offered by NOWPayments, making it a more cost-effective solution for creators.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure provides a permanent structural alternative to traditional platforms.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership, automation, and delivery are essential aspects of selling digital products. Sovereign commerce infrastructure prioritizes these elements, providing creators with full ownership of their data and products, automated payment processing, and instant delivery of digital goods. This level of control and automation enables creators to focus on producing high-quality products and growing their customer base, rather than worrying about the logistics of selling online.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on the creator's specific situation. For those in restricted countries or seeking more control over their digital business, sovereign commerce infrastructure is likely the best choice. This approach provides a permanent structural alternative to traditional platforms, ensuring that creators can sell their products without the risk of being locked out or restricted. By opting for a sovereign commerce infrastructure solution like the Edge Commerce Stack, creators can future-proof their businesses and maintain full ownership and control.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Crypto payments can offer faster transaction times and lower fees than traditional payment processing systems.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign commerce infrastructure solution, start by selecting a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, choose a backend logic solution such as Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Then, select an order storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets. After that, configure a file delivery system using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, integrate a crypto payment processing system like NOWPayments to complete your sovereign commerce stack.
